_note: The merchant banker's "specified date": "the date of exercising of the option" or "any date earlier than the date of the exercising of the option, not being a date which is more than one hundred and eighty days earlier" (S4 r.15(8)(l), Gazette 271092, p.1548; Rules 1962 r.3(8)(iv)(e), consolidated rule 3, p.5; D-121 C4a). A window of days, held as a DayWindow definition. Every regime.
